# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_DTE_OVERRIDE_1DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently trades 0DTE options, suffering from high theta decay and occasional fill slippage on rapid moves. Trading the same trigger on 1DTE options (next weekly expiry) should reduce theta impact, improve fill quality via wider bid-ask spreads, and maintain the same directional edge while allowing slightly wider stops to avoid premature exits on intraday noise.

## Mechanism

Identical trigger logic to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON: level rejection (close below premarket high/descending trendline/prior resistance), EMA ribbon flip (Fast < Pivot < Slow), and confluence with multi-day structure. Instead of 0DTE ATM/1st OTM put, trade 1DTE put at same strike offset (ATM or 1st OTM relative to underlying price at entry). Exit rules unchanged: chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer) as primary invalidation, chandelier profit-lock arms at +5% favor trailing 0.15 off HWM, premium stop at -50% catastrophe cap, time stop at 15:50 ET. Position sizing per risk-rules.md adjusted for 1DTE premium (e.g., fewer contracts to keep $-risk constant).
